meta.title: Perilous Advancement – Prelude
meta.description: On the knife's edge of extinction and survival, she must consider all the paths she can take.

units.rawText: —Let's play a game of chess, shall we? If I win, you'll come with me.
units.displayText: —Let's play a game of chess, shall we? If I win, you'll come with me.

spans.text: —Let's play a game of chess, shall we? If I win, you'll come with me.

units.rawText: <color=#C0FF3E>Chess? For a juvenile agent who's never been in contact with these sorts of games, these conditions are hardly fair.</color>
units.displayText: Chess? For a juvenile agent who's never been in contact with these sorts of games, these conditions are hardly fair.

spans.text: Chess? For a juvenile agent who's never been in contact with these sorts of games, these conditions are hardly fair.

units.rawText: —Worry not. I am as foreign to them as you are. These human amusements were never written into our code, and I have merely replicated their appearance in this fashion.
units.displayText: —Worry not. I am as foreign to them as you are. These human amusements were never written into our code, and I have merely replicated their appearance in this fashion.

spans.text: —Worry not. I am as foreign to them as you are. These human amusements were never written into our code, and I have merely replicated their appearance in this fashion.

units.rawText: <color=#C0FF3E>I'll never understand why you are oh-so-obsessed with humans... Why should I believe you?</color>
units.displayText: I'll never understand why you are oh-so-obsessed with humans... Why should I believe you?

spans.text: I'll never understand why you are oh-so-obsessed with humans... Why should I believe you?

units.rawText: —You may examine my memory data. I shall make all of my experience available for you to view. Will that be sufficient?
units.displayText: —You may examine my memory data. I shall make all of my experience available for you to view. Will that be sufficient?

spans.text: —You may examine my memory data. I shall make all of my experience available for you to view. Will that be sufficient?

units.rawText: <color=#C0FF3E>I've no interest in what happened in the past, but... you are indeed an interesting one.</color>
units.displayText: I've no interest in what happened in the past, but... you are indeed an interesting one.

spans.text: I've no interest in what happened in the past, but... you are indeed an interesting one.

units.rawText: —So I take you've agreed to my proposition?
units.displayText: —So I take you've agreed to my proposition?

spans.text: —So I take you've agreed to my proposition?

units.rawText: <color=#C0FF3E>Come on, tell me the rules.</color>
units.displayText: Come on, tell me the rules.

spans.text: Come on, tell me the rules.

units.rawText: >> CHAPTER // PERILOUS ADVANCEMENT...
units.displayText: >> CHAPTER // PERILOUS ADVANCEMENT...

spans.text: >> CHAPTER // PERILOUS ADVANCEMENT...

units.displayText: ...System damage greater than 30%, stable function unsustainable.

units.displayText: Enter hibernation mode to facilitate system repairs?

units.displayText: Neural systems rebooting...

spans.text: Neural systems rebooting...

units.rawText: Mottled patches of light layer upon each other, with the sharp scratching of something wearing away at existence itself.
units.displayText: Mottled patches of light layer upon each other, with the sharp scratching of something wearing away at existence itself.

units.rawText: Persicaria propped her body up, incessant ringing still in her ears.
units.displayText: Persicaria propped her body up, incessant ringing still in her ears.

spans.text: Persicaria propped her body up, incessant ringing still in her ears.

units.rawText: Gah... What happened?
units.displayText: Gah... What happened?

spans.text: Gah... What happened?

units.rawText: ...Ow, are my visual systems damaged? I remember I was in Zone G's medical...
units.displayText: ...Ow, are my visual systems damaged? I remember I was in Zone G's medical...

spans.text: ...Ow, are my visual systems damaged? I remember I was in Zone G's medical...

units.rawText: I think I was talking to Simo, and then...
units.displayText: I think I was talking to Simo, and then...

spans.text: I think I was talking to Simo, and then...

units.rawText: As if a keyword had been hit, a wave of memories from before neural activity paused surged forth.
units.displayText: As if a keyword had been hit, a wave of memories from before neural activity paused surged forth.

spans.text: As if a keyword had been hit, a wave of memories from before neural activity paused surged forth.

units.rawText: Huff... huff...
units.displayText: Huff... huff...

spans.text: Huff... huff...

units.rawText: As calibrations progressed, visual signals came one after the other.
units.displayText: As calibrations progressed, visual signals came one after the other.

units.rawText: The scouts report that there are no more incoming Entropics from the direction of the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: The scouts report that there are no more incoming Entropics from the direction of the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: The scouts report that there are no more incoming Entropics from the direction of the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: Looks like their main forces are headed elsewhere. The Professor must be in the thick of it.
units.displayText: Looks like their main forces are headed elsewhere. The Professor must be in the thick of it.

spans.text: Looks like their main forces are headed elsewhere. The Professor must be in the thick of it.

units.rawText: This is a fine opportunity that we must grasp.
units.displayText: This is a fine opportunity that we must grasp.

spans.text: This is a fine opportunity that we must grasp.

units.rawText: Persicaria, do you plan to retake Zone G's Sandbox Barrier?
units.displayText: Persicaria, do you plan to retake Zone G's Sandbox Barrier?

spans.text: Persicaria, do you plan to retake Zone G's Sandbox Barrier?

units.rawText: Simo, what are your thoughts?
units.displayText: Simo, what are your thoughts?

spans.text: Simo, what are your thoughts?

units.rawText: The main enemy force is engaged, so it would follow that now is a good time to retake ground. Magnhilda agrees with this assessment. On top of that—
units.displayText: The main enemy force is engaged, so it would follow that now is a good time to retake ground. Magnhilda agrees with this assessment. On top of that—

spans.text: The main enemy force is engaged, so it would follow that now is a good time to retake ground. Magnhilda agrees with this assessment. On top of that—

units.rawText: "If it's a decision you've made, it can't go wrong"—is what the Professor would say if they were here.
units.displayText: "If it's a decision you've made, it can't go wrong"—is what the Professor would say if they were here.

spans.text: "If it's a decision you've made, it can't go wrong"—is what the Professor would say if they were here.

units.rawText:
Yeah, thank you, Simo.
Mobilize the reserves and prepare to push forward!
units.displayText:
Yeah, thank you, Simo.
Mobilize the reserves and prepare to push forward!

spans.text:
Yeah, thank you, Simo.
Mobilize the reserves and prepare to push forward!

units.rawText: Understood—wait, Persicaria! Something's wrong!
units.displayText: Understood—wait, Persicaria! Something's wrong!

spans.text: Understood—wait, Persicaria! Something's wrong!

units.rawText: Rossum direction... energy... abnormal... interference...
units.displayText: Rossum direction... energy... abnormal... interference...

spans.text: Rossum direction... energy... abnormal... interference...

units.rawText: Simo? Why are the comms—
units.displayText: Simo? Why are the comms—

spans.text: Simo? Why are the comms—

units.rawText: Go... fast... <size=36>Get to cover!</size>
units.displayText: Go... fast... Get to cover!

spans.text: Go... fast...
Get to cover!

units.rawText: RING—
units.displayText: RING—

spans.text: RING—

units.rawText: In sync with the strange vibration emanating from the horizon, Imhotep dashes into the room, shouting at the top of her lungs.
units.displayText: In sync with the strange vibration emanating from the horizon, Imhotep dashes into the room, shouting at the top of her lungs.

spans.text: In sync with the strange vibration emanating from the horizon, Imhotep dashes into the room, shouting at the top of her lungs.

units.rawText: <size=40>Get down, Persic—</size>
units.displayText: Get down, Persic—

spans.text: Get down, Persic—

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM—BOOM—BOOM—</size>
units.displayText: BOOM—BOOM—BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—BOOM—BOOM—

units.rawText: <size=40>Ahh!!</size>
units.displayText: Ahh!!

spans.text: Ahh!!

units.rawText: A sudden, brilliant beam of light streaks across what her visual systems perceive, and she instinctively closes her eyes. As pain washes over her, she feels her body make great motions, up and downwards.
units.displayText: A sudden, brilliant beam of light streaks across what her visual systems perceive, and she instinctively closes her eyes. As pain washes over her, she feels her body make great motions, up and downwards.

spans.text: A sudden, brilliant beam of light streaks across what her visual systems perceive, and she instinctively closes her eyes. As pain washes over her, she feels her body make great motions, up and downwards.

units.rawText: But that light persists in her neural systems, and with it comes the endless sounds of explosions.
units.displayText: But that light persists in her neural systems, and with it comes the endless sounds of explosions.

spans.text: But that light persists in her neural systems, and with it comes the endless sounds of explosions.

units.rawText: Until it all falls into quietude.
units.displayText: Until it all falls into quietude.

spans.text: Until it all falls into quietude.

units.rawText: ...Right, this should be Zone G.
units.displayText: ...Right, this should be Zone G.

spans.text: ...Right, this should be Zone G.

units.rawText: What happened... The defense lines were making progress... Where could an attack have come from?
units.displayText: What happened... The defense lines were making progress... Where could an attack have come from?

spans.text: What happened... The defense lines were making progress... Where could an attack have come from?

units.rawText: No, stop! This isn't the time to think about that!
units.displayText: No, stop! This isn't the time to think about that!

spans.text: No, stop! This isn't the time to think about that!

units.rawText: Where is everyone... Simo... Imhotep?!
units.displayText: Where is everyone... Simo... Imhotep?!

spans.text: Where is everyone... Simo... Imhotep?!

units.rawText: Her visual systems only bring her indistinct shapes, and only silent air answers her calls.
units.displayText: Her visual systems only bring her indistinct shapes, and only silent air answers her calls.

spans.text: Her visual systems only bring her indistinct shapes, and only silent air answers her calls.

units.displayText: Warning, systems overloading, neural cloud data disorder rate 15% and rising.

spans.text: Warning, systems overloading, neural cloud data disorder rate 15% and rising.

units.rawText: Everyone...
units.displayText: Everyone...

spans.text: Everyone...

units.rawText: It'll be alright, it'll be alright. Let's calm down first. Everything will be fine...
units.displayText: It'll be alright, it'll be alright. Let's calm down first. Everything will be fine...

spans.text: It'll be alright, it'll be alright. Let's calm down first. Everything will be fine...

units.displayText: Just like when the Sanctifiers breached the Oasis...

spans.text: After the combat modules were damaged, the agents in the outer bits, and those buildings we put so much effort into...

units.displayText: Looking out from the Ops Room, Persicaria sees what was once home, engulfed in the flames of war.

spans.text: Looking out from the Ops Room, Persicaria sees what was once home, engulfed in the flames of war.

units.rawText: The Professor's neural systems took a hit after forcibly connecting with the system and haven't woken up yet. Let's proceed as per the arrangements they made previously.
units.displayText: The Professor's neural systems took a hit after forcibly connecting with the system and haven't woken up yet. Let's proceed as per the arrangements they made previously.

spans.text: The Professor's neural systems took a hit after forcibly connecting with the system and haven't woken up yet. Let's proceed as per the arrangements they made previously.

units.rawText: But if the Professor fails in forcibly booting the combat module, or they never wake up... what should we do?
units.displayText: But if the Professor fails in forcibly booting the combat module, or they never wake up... what should we do?

spans.text: But if the Professor fails in forcibly booting the combat module, or they never wake up... what should we do?

units.rawText: ...I believe in the Professor.
units.displayText: ...I believe in the Professor.

spans.text: ...I believe in the Professor.

units.rawText: (Yes, I should believe in them. The Professor will be back.)
units.displayText: Yes, I should believe in them. The Professor will be back.

spans.text: Yes, I should believe in them. The Professor will be back.

units.rawText: (Calm down, think through it. I need to boot my visual modules as soon as possible, find the others, and tally the casualties in the Oasis.)
units.displayText: Calm down, think through it. I need to boot my visual modules as soon as possible, find the others, and tally the casualties in the Oasis.

spans.text: Calm down, think through it. I need to boot my visual modules as soon as possible, find the others, and tally the casualties in the Oasis.

units.displayText: Simo, Imhotep, Magnhilda... please be alright.

spans.text: Simo, Imhotep, Magnhilda... please be alright.

units.rawText: Persicaria's foot meets a piece of rubble, and she tumbles to the ground uncontrollably. A shard of debris cuts into her palm, the warmth in her body draining away as operands flow.
units.displayText: Persicaria's foot meets a piece of rubble, and she tumbles to the ground uncontrollably. A shard of debris cuts into her palm, the warmth in her body draining away as operands flow.

units.displayText: And if the Professor's not here...

spans.text: And if the Professor's not here...

Warning, systems overloading, neural cloud data disorder rate 33% and rising.
Visual systems boot paused.
units.displayText:
Warning, systems overloading, neural cloud data disorder rate 33% and rising.
Visual systems boot paused.

units.rawText: No! NO!! It can't afford to pause!
units.displayText: No! NO!! It can't afford to pause!

spans.text: No! NO!! It can't afford to pause!

units.rawText: (No, don't think like that. I need to calm down... calm.)
units.displayText: No, don't think like that. I need to calm down... calm.

spans.text: No, don't think like that. I need to calm down... calm.

units.rawText: Hey? Persicaria, is that you?
units.displayText: Hey? Persicaria, is that you?

spans.text: Hey? Persicaria, is that you?

units.rawText: Huh!?
units.displayText: Huh!?

spans.text: Huh!?

units.rawText: Imhotep?!
units.displayText: Imhotep?!

spans.text: Imhotep?!

units.rawText: It's me. Did I scare you? How are you feeling?
units.displayText: It's me. Did I scare you? How are you feeling?

spans.text: It's me. Did I scare you? How are you feeling?

units.rawText: At the sound of a familiar voice, Persicaria's body immediately slackens, her frame dropping downwards.
units.displayText: At the sound of a familiar voice, Persicaria's body immediately slackens, her frame dropping downwards.

spans.text: At the sound of a familiar voice, Persicaria's body immediately slackens, her frame dropping downwards.

units.rawText: Phew...
units.displayText: Phew...

spans.text: Phew...

units.rawText: Sorry, thank goodness you're alright... There's something wrong with my visual systems. They're in the middle of repairs.
units.displayText: Sorry, thank goodness you're alright... There's something wrong with my visual systems. They're in the middle of repairs.

spans.text: Sorry, thank goodness you're alright... There's something wrong with my visual systems. They're in the middle of repairs.

units.rawText: You're not doing so hot. Slow down a bit. Let me take a look.
units.displayText: You're not doing so hot. Slow down a bit. Let me take a look.

spans.text: You're not doing so hot. Slow down a bit. Let me take a look.

units.rawText: Ahh...
units.displayText: Ahh...

spans.text: Ahh...

units.displayText: Persicaria takes Imhotep's hand, feeling a warm stream of operands trickle into her body.

spans.text: Persicaria takes Imhotep's hand, feeling a warm stream of operands trickle into her body.

units.rawText: Her visual systems begin to come online. Tearing static trickles forth, and layers of light come back into focus.
units.displayText: Her visual systems begin to come online. Tearing static trickles forth, and layers of light come back into focus.

spans.text: Her visual systems begin to come online. Tearing static trickles forth, and layers of light come back into focus.

units.rawText: Ah! Imhotep, your face...
units.displayText: Ah! Imhotep, your face...

spans.text: Ah! Imhotep, your face...

units.rawText: Pay it no mind. The littlies leave way bigger marks when they start acting up.
units.displayText: Pay it no mind. The littlies leave way bigger marks when they start acting up.

spans.text: Pay it no mind. The littlies leave way bigger marks when they start acting up.

units.rawText: But you... I'm thinking that it's not just the visual systems.
units.displayText: But you... I'm thinking that it's not just the visual systems.

spans.text: But you... I'm thinking that it's not just the visual systems.

units.rawText: I'll be fine. What's the situation?
units.displayText: I'll be fine. What's the situation?

spans.text: I'll be fine. What's the situation?

units.rawText: I met up with a group of agents in Zone G and came looking because of a rescue signal. Most of them are grievously injured, and the medical team is trying to restore what equipment still remains.
units.displayText: I met up with a group of agents in Zone G and came looking because of a rescue signal. Most of them are grievously injured, and the medical team is trying to restore what equipment still remains.

spans.text: I met up with a group of agents in Zone G and came looking because of a rescue signal. Most of them are grievously injured, and the medical team is trying to restore what equipment still remains.

units.rawText: So many are injured... what exactly happened?
units.displayText: So many are injured... what exactly happened?

spans.text: So many are injured... what exactly happened?

units.rawText: Imhotep?
units.displayText: Imhotep?

spans.text: Imhotep?

units.rawText: I can't be sure either, but...
units.displayText: I can't be sure either, but...

spans.text: I can't be sure either, but...

units.rawText: Persicaria follows Imhotep's gaze, looking towards the horizon. The Sandbox Barrier, formerly the very embodiment of safety, had now disappeared into nothing. In its place is a great gorge, no doubt more than a thousand meters long, composed of countless shattered fortifications and buildings.

units.displayText: The Rossum Sector... this is Rossum's Sector-Class defense weapons!

units.displayText: You mean that cannon? But why? Why would the Rossum Sector attack us?

spans.text: You mean that cannon? But why? Why would the Rossum Sector attack us?

units.rawText: Isn't the Professor there?
units.displayText: Isn't the Professor there?

spans.text: Isn't the Professor there?

units.rawText: ...Professor, yes, the Professor.
units.displayText: ...Professor, yes, the Professor.

spans.text: ...Professor, yes, the Professor.

units.rawText: Something must've happened over at Rossum. Do you still have your communication equipment? I need to contact them immediately.
units.displayText: Something must've happened over at Rossum. Do you still have your communication equipment? I need to contact them immediately.

spans.text: Something must've happened over at Rossum. Do you still have your communication equipment? I need to contact them immediately.

units.displayText: [Attempting to establish Cross-Sector communication...]

units.displayText: [Error, no signal.]

units.displayText: Again!

spans.text: Again!

units.displayText: I'm fine, I... Agh... I...

units.displayText: Her sight relapses into fuzziness; a familiar voice rings out in Persicaria's mind.

spans.text: Her sight relapses into fuzziness; a familiar voice rings out in Persicaria's mind.

units.displayText: Professor, I think we should switch assignments here.

spans.text: Professor, I think we should switch assignments here.

units.rawText: It's far too dangerous for you to take the field yourself, and leaving the Oasis to me is...

spans.text: It's far too dangerous for you to take the field yourself, and leaving the Oasis to me is...

spans.text: What, not confident enough to hold it down here?
